title: Prove production control-flow reachability before optimizing a fast path

source.title: Mooncake PR #3731 RDMA direct-path review
source.claim_scope: Review traced an eligible request to the old worker path; the primitive is a reachability gate.

implementation_recipe: Trace a representative eligible request from public entry to the intended fast primitive.
Add a branch/counter assertion that distinguishes fast and fallback paths.
Benchmark only after production reachability and completion semantics are proven.
validation_recipe: Test one eligible request, one ineligible request and one negotiation/capability failure.
Verify completion, cancellation and error propagation on both paths.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: An unreachable path has exactly zero production speedup regardless of microbenchmark quality.
failure_modes: The shortcut returns success but calls the old scheduler.
A fallback masks that the fast branch was never entered.
The data path is wired but completion polling remains on the old queue.
scope_limits: A reachability proof is necessary but not sufficient for correctness or performance.

candidate_archetypes.name: instrumented end-to-end fast dispatch
candidate_archetypes.template: Wire and instrument the complete request lifecycle before any low-level tuning.
